nodes.title: Number of sites of a box

nodes.summary: For every site `x`, `ℙ_p(0 ↔ x) ≤ ℙ_p(0 ↔ ℤ^d \ Λ_{‖x‖_∞ - 1})` once `‖x‖_∞ ≥ 1`: the site `x` itself lies outside `Λ_{‖x‖_∞ - 1}`.
nodes.title: Connection probabilities are bounded by one-arm probabilities

nodes.summary: For `p ≤ q`, `ℙ_p(0 ↔ x inside S) ≤ ℙ_q(0 ↔ x inside S)` (H. Duminil-Copin, *Introduction to Bernoulli percolation*, lecture notes, 2018, Corollary 2.2, applied to the increasing event `{0 ↔ x inside S}`).
nodes.title: Monotonicity of connection probabilities inside a finite set

nodes.summary: Exponential decay below `p_c` for Bernoulli bond percolation on `ℤ^d`, `d ≥ 1`: for every `p < p_c(d)` there are `c, C > 0` with `ℙ_p(0 ↔ ℤ^d \ Λ_{n-1}) ≤ C e^{-cn}` for all `n` (H. Duminil-Copin, *Introduction to Bernoulli percolation*, lecture notes, 2018, Theorem 3.3, first assertion; Duminil-Copin and Tassion, Comm. Math. Phys. 343 (2016), Theorem 1.1, item 3). The lecture notes state the bound as `exp(-c_p n)`…
nodes.title: Exponential decay below `p_c`

nodes.summary: Exponential decay of the one-arm probability for every `p ∈ tildePcSet d`, i.e. every `p` admitting a finite `S ∋ 0` with `φ_p(S) < 1`.
nodes.title: Exponential decay of the one-arm probability below the threshold

nodes.summary: The event `{o ↔ x inside S}` is increasing: opening edges keeps an open path open.
nodes.title: Connection inside a set is an increasing event

nodes.summary: The direction sequence of the straight path from the origin along the first coordinate axis.

nodes.summary: If some finite `S ∋ 0` has `φ_q(S) < 1` and `p ≤ q`, the same `S` has `φ_p(S) < 1`.
nodes.title: The densities with φ_p(S) < 1 for some S form a down-set

nodes.summary: Every density strictly below `p̃_c(d) = sup tildePcSet d` lies in `tildePcSet d`.
nodes.title: Every density below p̃_c admits a finite set with φ_p(S) < 1

nodes.summary: For every finite `S` and `p ≤ q`, `φ_p(S) ≤ φ_q(S)`, where `φ_p(S) = p ∑_{xy ∈ ΔS} ℙ_p(0 ↔ x inside S)` (H. Duminil-Copin, *Introduction to Bernoulli percolation*, lecture notes, 2018, equation (3.4)). Both factors are nondecreasing in `p`: the prefactor trivially, and each connection probability by `connWithinProb_mono`.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the Duminil-Copin–Tassion quantity

Math. Phys. 343 (2016), Theorem 1.1 and the nearest-neighbour bound of §1.2). For Bernoulli bond percolation on `ℤ^d`, `d ≥ 1`:

nodes.summary: Sharpness of the phase transition for Bernoulli bond percolation on `ℤ^d`, `d ≥ 1` (Duminil-Copin–Tassion 2016; Aizenman–Barsky 1987; Menshikov 1986):
nodes.title: Sharpness of the phase transition

nodes.summary: For `c > 0` the sequence `k ↦ (2k + 1)^d e^{-ck}` is summable.
nodes.title: Summability of polynomially weighted exponentials

nodes.summary: Finite susceptibility below `p_c` (Duminil-Copin and Tassion, Comm. Math. Phys. 343 (2016), Theorem 1.1, item 2). For Bernoulli bond percolation on `ℤ^d`, `d ≥ 1`, and every `p < p_c(d)`, the susceptibility `∑_{x ∈ ℤ^d} ℙ_p(0 ↔ x)` is finite: the family `x ↦ ℙ_p(0 ↔ x)` is summable.
nodes.title: Finite susceptibility below `p_c`

nodes.summary: The sup-norm `‖x‖_∞ = max_i |x_i|` of a site, as a natural number.
nodes.title: Sup-norm of a lattice site

nodes.summary: `θ_d(p) = 0` for every `p < p_c(d)`, `d ≥ 1`. The definition `p_c = sup {p : θ(p) = 0}` gives this only together with monotonicity of `θ`; here it follows from exponential decay (`crossProb_exp_decay_of_lt_pc`).
nodes.title: No percolation below `p_c`
